note: state/owner-mail.json {<key>: {at, status, to|id|why}} plus its .lock and .tmp.<pid> siblings: bin/lib/owner-mail.sh owner_mail, a read-modify-write under flock that stamps a key BEFORE the send so a crash costs a lost repeat, never a second mail.
